claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + species_trait mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. No SpeciesTraitRecord exists. The taxonomy defines species_trait_root as a source atom but types.ts defines no mechanics family or record shape to hold it. Every species trait family currently lacks a payload schema.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Powerful Build is a species_trait; forcing it into ClassFeatureRecord would require fabricating className and acquiredAtLevel, which have no honest mapping.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_check in RollKind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The grapple-escape mechanic grants Advantage specifically on ability checks (Athletics / Acrobatics). RollKind = 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' — ability checks are absent. Even if a species_trait record existed, modify_roll_advantage on ability_check could not be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_size_category (passive, for encumbrance rules)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Counting as one size larger for carrying capacity is a non-combat passive property that modifies character-sheet calculations (Lifting/Carrying from SRD Equipment). It has no combat mechanic counterpart and likely sits outside core runtime scope per ARCHITECTURE.md. If the surface is to record it at all, a dedicated atom distinct from combat-facing modify_speed or grant_hover is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
